entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: Icy-breathed elder dragon of Tarkir, a dragonlord who ruled Clan Ojutai and was defeated by the spirit dragons.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Planeswalker dragon whose dragon tempests produced the brood.

entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: Jeskai leader whose terms of surrender Ojutai accepted.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Ojutai's best and favorite student who uncovered the Stormnexus Ritual.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: Outcast who approached Ojutai to propose cooperation between dragons and non-dragons.

entities.name: Clan Ojutai
entities.description: Clan led by Ojutai, devoted to enlightenment from the dragons.

entities.name: Khanfall of Tarkir
entities.description: Fall of the khans to the dragonlords.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: Ritual that summoned five spirit dragons.

entities.name: Spirit dragons
entities.description: Five dragons bound to the new clan leaders.

events.summary: Ojutai takes over the Jeskai by attacking the khans' meeting and orders execution of every ghostfire warrior after Shu Yun's surrender.
events.quote: Ojutai ordered the execution of every Jeskai ghostfire warrior

events.summary: Ojutai has history rewritten and punishes deviation as heresy.
events.quote: declaring himself ruler and founder of the clan

events.summary: Ojutai spares Narset after she finds the original clans.
events.quote: allowed her to live after she discovered the existence of the original clans

events.summary: Zurgo approaches Ojutai and the dragonlord agrees to cooperate.
events.quote: With the dragons' numbers decimated by the invaders, Ojutai agreed.

events.summary: Narset uncovers the Stormnexus Ritual and is convinced to use it.
events.quote: she uncovered a spell scroll for the Stormnexus Ritual

events.summary: The ritual summons five spirit dragons and the dragonlords are defeated and swallowed by the storm.
events.quote: the dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm

relations.quote: As the new leader, Ojutai demanded
his best and favorite student: Narset
the partnership of dragonlord and despised outcast
